t: Sidekick Books is a small press based in London. It was founded by two poets, Jon Stone and Kirsten Irving. Stone is the author of two books and several pamphlets of poetry, and his poems have appeared in The Sunday Times, Poetry Review, Poetry London and The Rialto. Together they have published collaborative poetry anthologies, many of which Stone co-edited. Irving is a poet, editor and voice actor who also lives and works in London. It's a small operation, built by two writers who wanted to publish poetry.
